SPC Quality Monitoring

Python · PostgreSQL · SQL · SPC · Statistical Analysis

Built an end-to-end SPC workflow for manufacturing quality monitoring, using a synthetic powder-coating dataset to demonstrate how production measurements can be transformed into statistical quality insights.

What I built
  • SQL-based data preparation and analysis
  • Control charts for process monitoring
  • Cp/Cpk and Pp/Ppk process capability analysis
  • Quality-focused measurement and reporting workflow
Why it matters

The project connects shop-floor quality measurements with statistical analysis to identify process shifts, assess stability and support data-driven improvement.
